fields.title: Fracture & Trauma Surgery
fields.description:
A fracture or traumatic injury can happen unexpectedly and significantly affect mobility, independence, work, sport, and everyday life. Whether it is a simple fracture, a complex joint injury, or a high-energy trauma, timely diagnosis and appropriate treatment are essential for optimal recovery. 

Dr Ulhas Sonar provides comprehensive fracture and trauma care in Pune, including emergency assessment, fracture management, surgical fixation, complex trauma reconstruction, and rehabilitation planning. Treatment is tailored to the specific injury, patient requirements, and long-term functional goals, with a focus on restoring alignment, stability, movement, and return to daily activities.

faqs.question: What happens during a fracture consultation?
faqs.answer: Your consultation includes a detailed assessment of the injury, clinical examination, and review of X-rays or scans. Dr Ulhas Sonar will explain the diagnosis, discuss treatment options, and create a personalised recovery plan.

faqs.question: How long does fracture healing take?
faqs.answer: Healing times vary depending on the bone involved, fracture type, age, and overall health. Most fractures begin healing within weeks, although full recovery and return to normal activities may take longer.

faqs.question: When is surgery recommended for a fracture?
faqs.answer: Surgery may be recommended when a fracture is displaced, unstable, involves a joint surface, causes deformity, or cannot be managed effectively with non-surgical treatment alone.

faqs.question: What is the difference between simple and complex fractures?
faqs.answer: Simple fractures usually involve a single clean break and are often easier to treat. Complex fractures may involve multiple fragments, joint surfaces, significant displacement, or severe trauma requiring advanced surgical management.

faqs.question: Can fractures heal without surgery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many fractures heal well without surgery when alignment is acceptable, and the bone remains stable. The most appropriate treatment depends on the fracture pattern, location, and functional requirements of the patient.

faqs.question: How soon can I return to work or sports after a fracture?
faqs.answer: Return to work or sport depends on the fracture type, treatment received, and healing progress. A personalised rehabilitation plan helps ensure a safe return while minimising the risk of reinjury.

fields.about_description: Fracture and trauma surgery involves the diagnosis, treatment, and reconstruction of injuries affecting bones, joints, ligaments, tendons, and surrounding soft tissues. Treatment may range from non-surgical fracture management to advanced surgical fixation and complex trauma reconstruction depending on the nature of the injury.

journey_steps.title: Detailed Consultation
journey_steps.description: The process begins with a careful discussion of symptoms, walking ability, pain pattern, stiffness, previous treatment, medical history, work needs and lifestyle goals.

journey_steps.title: Clinical Examination
journey_steps.description: Dr Ulhas Sonar assesses joint movement, alignment, deformity, stability, walking pattern, swelling and functional limitations.

journey_steps.title: Imaging Review
journey_steps.description: X-rays, MRI scans, CT scans or previous surgical records may be reviewed to understand the severity of arthritis, implant condition, bone quality and joint alignment.

journey_steps.title: Personalised Treatment Planning
journey_steps.description: Treatment may include non-surgical care, physiotherapy, injections, knee preservation, partial knee replacement, total knee replacement, robotic knee replacement, hip replacement or revision surgery depending on the diagnosis.

journey_steps.title: Surgery When Appropriate
journey_steps.description: If surgery is required, the procedure is planned according to the patient’s anatomy, joint damage, health condition and recovery expectations.
